feeds.title: Indianapolis Monthly
feeds.description: Indianapolis Monthly, the city's authoritative general interest magazine, provides its loyal monthly readers with compelling narrative stories and smart, lively service pieces. The magazine not only reflects the interests of Indianapolis but sparks conversation with its coverage of politics, sports, crime, lifestyle, entertainment, restaurants, culture, business, and the big personalities that make the Circle City go round.

feeds.title: Indy's Child Magazine
feeds.description: Indy's Child Parenting Magazine is a local and nationally award-winning parenting magazine. Discover the latest local to-dos or parenting support how-tos! Their mission is to educate, update, and inform parents by providing them with the tools, resources, events, and contacts they need to make parenthood a little easier.

feeds.title: Indy with Kids
feeds.description: My name is Katy Mann, and I'm the creator of Indy with Kids. With over 10 years of experience working with children and my excitement towards the great city of Indianapolis; I offer readers guidance about great events and activities to do around Indianapolis with their kids and grandchildren. Join us on our family travels and adventures across the country!

feeds.title: Indiana Historical Society Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog for the Indiana Historical Society. Indiana Historical Society has been Indiana's StorytellerTM, connecting people to the past by collecting, preserving and sharing the state's history. They provides support and assistance to local museums and historical groups; publishes books and periodicals; sponsors teacher workshops; produces and hosts art exhibitions, museum theater and outside performance groups; and provides youth, adult and family programming.

feeds.title: Two Twenty One
feeds.description: Two Twenty One is a DIY home and lifestyle blog, where Chelsea shares her home improvement projects, crafts, recipes, home & seasonal decor ideas, organization ideas, tips & tricks, and more. Chelsea, the author of Two Twenty One, is a millennial wife and mom living in Indianapolis, Indiana.

feeds.title: PERQ
feeds.description: PERQ, a marketing technology company founded in 2001, empowers businesses and the online consumer experience through innovative solutions powered by artificial intelligence. More than 1,000 businesses in the home furnishings, auto retailing and multifamily industries leverage PERQ's Marketing Cloud and technology to give them more visibility into their digital marketing efforts and sales.

feeds.title: Abby Saylor Armbruster
feeds.description: Abby is an Indianapolis-based blogger and newlywed working in the PR industry, sharing all things life and style. Her blog is a hub for all of her thoughts, interests, tips and inspiration directed toward fellow style lovers and young professionals. You'll find all of those things and more here with a glimpse into her personal life, travels and trusted recommendations!

feeds.title: Indy Coupon Mama
feeds.description: Passing on Savings, Deals and Coupons to the Indianapolis, Indiana and surrounding areas. Tara is the author behind Indy Coupon Mama and helps families on buying and savings household stuff.

feeds.title: Urban Indy
feeds.description: Urban Indy is a collaborative blog featuring authors with a passion for urban design in Indianapolis.

feeds.title: Indianapolis Restaurant Scene | Honest Indy Restaurant Reviews...and other random thoughts
feeds.description: I moved 'back home again' to Indiana in the summer of 2006 after spending many years in San Francisco. I grew up in Indy, but it was while I was living elsewhere that I developed a true love of food. I was excited to see what Indy had to offer, but I was discouraged by the lack of any truthful reviews of restaurants in Indianapolis. I decided to take it upon myself to start this blog in which I can share with you my personal, honest, and unbiased take on the restaurant scene in Indy.

feeds.title: Circle City Kids
feeds.description: Midwestern family with 2 adventurous boys and 1 lazy dog. They enjoy new adventures great and small and sharing their experiences with others. Let's roll!

feeds.title: Indiana Owned
feeds.description: Indiana Originals is a growing, statewide directory of products, services, artisans, and businesses established and operating in Indiana. Indiana Originals exists to help encourage a local preference and facilitate a greater use of local businesses, services, art, food and more.

feeds.title: The Indiana Insider Blog
feeds.description: The Indiana Office of Tourism Development (IOTD) works to coordinate efforts to promote travel throughout Indiana. Additionally, IOTD assists to enhance the visitor experience by providing up-to-date travel information for pre-planning activities and the duration of their Indiana vacation. Indiana has abundant beauty, relaxation and rejuvenation, culture and charisma, excitement and entertainment.

feeds.title: Downtown Indy Blog
feeds.description: Downtown Indy, Inc. is action-oriented and empowered to address critical issues that affect the growth, well-being and user-friendliness of Downtown Indianapolis. It is the only non-profit organization charged with developing, managing, activating and marketing Downtown to make it a better place to work, live, learn and play.

feeds.title: Visit Indiana | Indiana Office of Tourism Development
feeds.description: Sharing the best events, attractions, trips & food in the Hoosier State!

feeds.title: My Brunette Adventure Indianapolis Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: My Brunette Adventure is a Indianapolis Lifestyle Blog, publishing personal Style, Decor, DIY's, Travel, and Home adventures of a boutique owner.

feeds.title: theCityMoms | Not your average moms group
feeds.description: theCityMoms is not your average moms group. We're the social and support community for moms in the greater Indianapolis area.
